acceptanceCriteria: The verify-file grammar admits a quoted -run pattern (or a documented escape) with a maintained test, or the refusal names the escape to use.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 in lane V1-1278 S2b (origin/main dc6811176). cmd/corvint had to run as five -run groups (`-run '^Test[A-C]'` etc.) under -timeout 30m, but the verify-file grammar refuses lines containing quotes or brackets, so verify.txt could only list the unsplit command; the PR body and build log state what actually ran. Expected: the retained verify record can name the exact commands run. Actual: the record is less precise than the run. Related: V1-1018 (verify commands with an author).
title: dogfood change: DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE refuses quotes and brackets, so a -run group split cannot be recorded
